% TS1 symbols that tex4ht's file for the Latin Modern TS1 fonts
% (lm-ts1.htf) maps to another character. Each symbol is set after a label
% in Latin Modern, in txfonts' Times, and in TeX Gyre Heros, which takes the
% Latin Modern file. txfonts' file, tcxb.htf, is the Latin Modern file with
% two more errors, for \textblank and \textquotesingle.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{textcomp}
\begin{document}
